blocks.text: What changed with voice on the Mac

Voice on the Mac has changed twice this year, and many guides still describe the old version. OpenAI said in December 2025 that it would retire the Voice experience in the ChatGPT macOS app on January 15, 2026. According to 9to5Mac, no other ChatGPT features on macOS were affected by that change.

After that date, Mac users had to use the web app or the iPhone and iPad app to talk to ChatGPT out loud. That gap ended on July 23, 2026, when OpenAI released ChatGPT Voice in the desktop app for macOS and Windows. Digital Applied reports that the Mac release arrived in build 26.715, and that it is powered by GPT-Live.

If you remember a headphone icon at the bottom right of the window, that memory comes from an older version. The Mac Install Guide page still describes that icon, and it refers to Advanced Voice Mode from before 2026. Skip that instruction and use the steps on this page.
Before you start: plan, app build and microphone

Three things decide whether voice works for you on a Mac. The first is your plan. The second is the app build. The third is whether macOS lets ChatGPT use your microphone. Check them in that order, because the first two can block everything after them.

On desktop, voice is listed for Plus, Pro, Business, Edu and Enterprise. Digital Applied says Free and Go are excluded. In the sources checked for this page, Free accounts do not get desktop voice at all. Voice is also app-only, so it is not available through an API key.

items: Plan: confirm the plan name on your account before you install or reinstall anything.
Build: the Mac app should be build 26.715 or later. Find the build number in the app's About information.
Microphone: allow ChatGPT in System Settings, under Privacy & Security, then Microphone.
Audio: test a headset before a long session, since the built-in microphone can cause feedback.
Connection: use the network you normally work on, and test it with one short question.

blocks.text: Use the web version when the Mac app is not an option

The web version is a useful fallback while you confirm the app. The chatgpt.com home page shows a voice icon in the chat input area, after the Web search label. That icon links to chatgpt.com/?mode=voice, so you can open voice straight from a browser tab.

Browsers ask for microphone access the first time you use it. You can change that choice later in the browser settings. The sources tie screen context to the Mac app, so do not count on it in the browser. Choose the app when the window in focus matters to the conversation.

blocks.text: How long voice lasts on your plan

Voice time is capped, and the sources do not agree on the cap. ToolColumn lists Plus at 3 hours per rolling 24 hours, and says voice ends once those hours run out. Digital Applied reports a rolling five-hour window, with about 15 to 30 minutes for Plus.

rows: $100 plan: 15 hours. $200 plan: unlimited, subject to abuse guardrails
Pro 5x: about 1 to 2.5 hours. Pro 20x: unlimited

blocks.text: Those numbers are far apart, so do not plan a long session around either one. Check OpenAI's current limit for your plan before you rely on it. OpenAI's help pages could not be opened when this page was checked.
A worked example: a 20-minute voice session on Plus

Say you want a 20-minute voice session to walk through a report draft. On ToolColumn's Plus figure, 3 hours is 180 minutes, so that session uses about 11 percent of the 24-hour allowance. The same 20 minutes falls inside Digital Applied's Plus allowance of 15 to 30 minutes per five-hour window, so it could use most of that allowance.
Two habits help. Keep voice for talking tasks, such as drafting, reviewing and answering questions. Type short lookups and copy-paste work, so your voice minutes go to the parts that need your voice.
Microphone and audio problems on a Mac

Most voice failures on a Mac come from audio routing, and the sources on this page point the same way. A developer forum thread from October 2025 describes a MacBook Pro where the voice reply started, cut off and repeated several times. The user said it began after the 1.2025.105 update.

Other apps played sound normally on that Mac, and the same voice worked on an iPhone. That pattern suggests the Mac app's audio path, not the speakers. Test the same question on an iPhone or in the web app to find which side fails.
Headsets, feedback and the built-in microphone

The built-in microphone can pick up the voice coming out of your speakers. Forum users reported that this caused feedback, and that a headset avoided it. These are user reports, not official guidance from OpenAI.

Wired headsets and earbuds worked for some users in the same thread. HDMI audio made the voice stop after a word or two and loop. AirPods made the voice sound slow and distorted for at least one user. Test one device at a time, and note which one works.
How many people talk to AI, and how often

Voice is still a smaller habit than typing, even as chatbot use grows. In Pew's February 2026 survey of 5,119 US adults, 49% said they ever use AI chatbots, and 24% use them daily. Menlo Ventures' July 2026 survey found that 19% of AI users say voice is their main way to use AI.
Screen context: when voice can see your window

On a Mac, voice can reference the window that has focus. 9to5Mac calls this feature Appshots. Digital Applied says the setting is opt-in for each session, and that it is not available on Windows at launch.
Turn it on only for the window you want discussed. Before a session, close anything private that sits on screen next to the work. It takes a few seconds and avoids surprises later.
What to do when voice mode is missing

If voice does not show up, work through three checks in order. Confirm the plan. Confirm the build number. Confirm the microphone permission. Stop at the first failure, because the later checks will not fix an earlier one.

If the account is on Free or Go, the sources checked do not list desktop voice for it. An upgrade to a listed plan is the route to desktop voice in those sources. Use the web route in the meantime, and check its limits on OpenAI's site.
Mistakes people make with voice mode on a Mac

items: Following a guide with a headphone icon. That icon belongs to the older Mac voice mode that ended on January 15, 2026.
Using one limit figure for everyone. The sources disagree about Plus limits, so check OpenAI's current number.
Testing with the built-in microphone and the speakers on at full volume. Feedback can follow.
Skipping the Microphone permission, then blaming ChatGPT when nothing is heard.
Starting a long session without tracking time, so voice stops in the middle of a task.
Expecting voice through an API key. Desktop voice is app-only, according to Digital Applied.

blocks.text: A first-week routine that avoids the usual traps
Spend your first session on a two-minute test. Ask one question, listen to the answer and check that the voice is clear. If it cuts off or loops, switch to a headset before you try anything longer.

Then use voice for one real task a day, such as drafting a reply or reading back notes. Write down the time you use, so you know how close you are to your plan's limit before it stops you mid-sentence.
Next steps and related guides

For a keyboard route into ChatGPT on your Mac, read [How to use the Option+Space shortcut in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/use-the-option-space-shortcut-in-chatgpt). It covers a different way in, so you can try both and keep the one that fits your day.

For how voice works with the window you are using, read [ChatGPT voice on Mac and the screen: can it see your window?](/blog/chatgpt-voice-mac-screen). To compare the ChatGPT Mac app with other tools for daily work, see [ChatGPT on Mac compared with other options](/apps/chatgpt).

faq.question: Is voice mode back in ChatGPT on Mac?
faq.answer: Yes, in the desktop app. OpenAI released ChatGPT Voice in the desktop app for macOS and Windows on July 23, 2026, powered by GPT-Live. The older Mac voice experience was retired on January 15, 2026, so the 2026 release is a new start.

faq.question: Which plans include voice in the Mac app?
faq.answer: Plus, Pro, Business, Edu and Enterprise, according to Digital Applied. The same report says Free and Go are excluded. Check your plan name before you install or reinstall the app.

faq.question: How long can I use voice mode in ChatGPT on Mac?
faq.answer: The sources disagree. ToolColumn lists Plus at 3 hours per rolling 24 hours. Digital Applied lists about 15 to 30 minutes for Plus in a rolling five-hour window. Check OpenAI's current limit before a long session.

faq.question: Is there a keyboard shortcut for voice mode?
faq.answer: The sources checked for this page do not list a keyboard shortcut for voice, so this page does not give one. For the Option+Space shortcut in ChatGPT, read the separate guide linked in the next steps section.

faq.question: Can voice mode see what is on my screen?
faq.answer: On macOS, voice can reference the window in focus. Digital Applied says the setting is opt-in per session and is not available on Windows at launch. Turn it on only for the window you want discussed.

faq.question: Can I use voice mode in ChatGPT through the API?
faq.answer: No, according to Digital Applied. Desktop voice is app-only and is not available through an API key. Use the app, or the web voice route for this.

faq.question: Why does my Mac pick up ChatGPT's voice?
faq.answer: The built-in microphone can hear the speakers. Forum users reported feedback from it, and a headset stopped the feedback in their tests. Use a headset, or keep the volume lower while you test.

faq.question: Does voice work on iPhone too?
faq.answer: Yes. After the Mac voice was retired, 9to5Mac pointed users to the web app or the iOS and iPadOS app to talk out loud. A developer forum thread also reports the same voice working on an iPhone.

steps.name: Confirm your plan
steps.text: Desktop voice is listed for Plus, Pro, Business, Edu and Enterprise. Free and Go are excluded in the sources checked. If your plan is not on that list, voice in the Mac app depends on an upgrade.
steps.tip: Your plan name appears with your account details. Check it before you update or reinstall anything.

steps.name: Check the app build
steps.text: Desktop voice first shipped in build 26.715 on July 23, 2026. Open the app's About information and confirm the build number is 26.715 or later. If it is older, install the current app from OpenAI before you go on.
steps.tip: If no update is offered, quit the app, open it again and check the build number a second time.

steps.name: Start a new chat in voice mode
steps.text: Open the ChatGPT app and start a new chat. 9to5Mac reports that voice can start a new chat or task, and that you can then ask ChatGPT to check or steer work in other threads.

steps.name: Find the voice control
steps.text: Look for the voice button in the message box, which is usually at the bottom of the window. The sources do not confirm its exact label on the Mac, so look for a microphone or waveform symbol next to where you type.
steps.tip: On the web, the voice icon sits in the same spot, after the Web search label.

steps.name: Allow microphone access
steps.text: If macOS asks, choose Allow. To set it yourself, open System Settings, choose Privacy & Security, then Microphone, and switch on ChatGPT in the list.
steps.tip: One forum user said turning microphone access off and on fixed a problem. Others said it did not help, so treat it as a first check.

steps.name: Connect your headset
steps.text: Plug in a wired headset or earbuds before you start the session. Forum users reported that a headset stopped feedback from the built-in microphone. If the voice plays from the wrong device, check System Settings > Sound.

steps.name: Ask your first question
steps.text: Speak one full question, then pause. Keep the first session short. A two-minute test shows whether the voice is clear, and whether the reply cuts off or repeats.

steps.name: Turn on screen context only if you need it
steps.text: Screen context lets voice reference the window in focus on macOS, a feature 9to5Mac calls Appshots. Digital Applied says it is opt-in for each session. Look for the option when you start the session, and turn it on only for the window you want discussed.
steps.tip: The option's label is not confirmed in the sources, so check it in your own app before the session.

steps.name: Keep an eye on your allowance
steps.text: Voice ends once your included hours run out, according to ToolColumn. Note when you start, and stop a long session before the limit cuts it off mid-sentence.

steps.name: Use the web route if the app fails
steps.text: Open a browser and go to chatgpt.com/?mode=voice. The chatgpt.com home page shows a voice icon in the chat input, next to the Web search label, and that icon links to the same address.

troubleshooting.problem: Voice starts, cuts off and repeats
troubleshooting.fix: A developer forum report from October 2025 describes this on a MacBook Pro after the 1.2025.105 update. Switch to a wired headset, quit the app and open it again, then test with one short question. If it continues, report it to OpenAI with your build number.

troubleshooting.problem: Other apps have sound but ChatGPT voice does not
troubleshooting.fix: The same forum thread describes that pattern, with the voice working on an iPhone. Check the output device in System Settings > Sound, then test with a headset. If the iPhone works and the Mac does not, the problem sits in the Mac app.

troubleshooting.problem: The Mac microphone picks up ChatGPT and feeds back
troubleshooting.fix: Use a headset. Forum users reported feedback from the built-in microphone, and a headset stopped it. Keep the volume lower while you test.

troubleshooting.problem: Toggling microphone access or logging out does not help
troubleshooting.fix: Forum replies are mixed. One user said toggling microphone access fixed it, and others said it did not. Changing voice settings and logging out were reported not to work either, so test a headset before you spend more time on settings.

troubleshooting.problem: Voice option is missing in the app
troubleshooting.fix: Check the plan first. Desktop voice is listed for Plus, Pro, Business, Edu and Enterprise. Then confirm the build is 26.715 or later. A headphone icon in an older guide belongs to the retired Mac voice mode, not the 2026 version.

troubleshooting.problem: Voice stops partway through a session
troubleshooting.fix: You likely reached the plan's voice allowance. ToolColumn says voice ends when the included hours run out, and Digital Applied lists much shorter windows for Plus. Check OpenAI's current limit and plan shorter sessions.
